minutes.headline: Master Plan Steering Committee held its first meeting, elected a chair and vice chair, and heard the consultant's outline of the process.
minutes.summary: At its inaugural meeting the committee introduced members, elected a chair and a vice chair by roll call, and heard the land use director and the consultant describe the master plan process, the discovery phase and public outreach plans. Members discussed a monthly evening meeting schedule, tentatively the first Thursday at six. A resident asked about the engagement plan, website, surveys and committee size, and the meeting adjourned by roll call.

what_happened.line: The Master Plan Steering Committee elected a chair and a vice chair by roll call at its first meeting; the counts were not clearly audible.
The land use director and the consultant described the master plan process, the discovery phase and plans for public outreach.
Members leaned toward meeting monthly in the evening, with the first Thursday at six proposed as the likely slot.
Consultants aim to hold the next public meeting in late October or early November to present the existing conditions report.
A resident asked where the engagement plan is posted, when the website goes live, how members were chosen and how large the committee is, and said the process is behind schedule.

why_it_matters: The master plan is the town's long-range guide to land use, and this committee will shape it, so the outreach schedule and the engagement plan decide when and how residents can weigh in.
watch_next: A public meeting in late October or early November to present the existing conditions report.
